regression_remediation_applied.root_cause: T-092 attaches Depends(get_current_user) to all 11 V1 routers in src/main.py:45-55. Pre-V2 test suites (S1/S2/S3 API tests, IS-001..IS-012 scenarios, ST-001..ST-012 system tests) were written against DS-005 (V1 open) and issued unauthenticated requests, receiving 401 instead of their pre-V2 expected status codes.

changes.description: SECRET_KEY seeded at import (mirrors DATABASE_URL pattern). Module-level _DEFAULT_SUPERVISOR_PASSWORD_HASH precomputed once via bcrypt to amortise cost across the whole session. client fixture now seeds a __test_default_supervisor__ UserModel row into db_session, mints an 8h HS256 JWT via create_access_token, and attaches Authorization: Bearer <token> to TestClient.headers so every legacy S1/S2/S3 client.<verb>(...) call authenticates by default. Added unauthenticated_client fixture (no default header) for the two negative-path tests below.

Rewrote parametrized test to use unauthenticated_client and assert status_code == 401 with WWW-Authenticate: Bearer header (RFC 6750). Docstring updated to cite DS-025 supersession of DS-005. Function renamed test_st002_list_endpoints_require_auth (was ..._no_auth_required).

Rewrote 4 assertions to expect 401 against unauthenticated_client (no header + bogus Bearer, on /dashboard and /reports/sales). Added a 5th positive-control assertion using the authenticated client fixture to confirm the guard is not blanket-blocking. Function renamed test_st011_s3_endpoints_require_auth.
TC-213 (unauthenticated V1 endpoint returns 401) was implicitly authenticated by the new default client fixture. Switched to unauthenticated_client so the assertion tests the intended contract.

changes_not_needed: 33 S1/S2/S3 API integration tests, 10 IS-001..IS-012 scenarios, 24 remaining system/security tests — all pass unmodified because they consume the client fixture which now authenticates by default. Zero test-body edits required in that set.
